title: ::: PSS-OFF 영어듣기훈련프로그램 | 기초2 | 제 001 회 강의 :::
label: [ Passoff Reading 104 ]

blocks.text: Mexico attracts different types of visitors.
One group is composed of artists. As admirers of the Mexican culture,
they want to be close to the subjects they are writing about or
painting. Another group consists of retirees who also need to live on
reduced incomes. They like the unhurried way of life with its long
afternoon nap and they enjoy the temperate climate. The third group is
attracted by the resort with its colorful night life. In Acapulco, they can
play all night, and swim in the warm ocean water.
